title: Electric Eye of Tears
description: A large green eye with a detailed iris sits at the center of a glowing purple cabbage-like flower. The eye and a melting pink heart below it drip thick magenta liquid, all contained within a translucent iridescent sphere surrounded by white lightning and floating smaller eyes against a dark purple background.
prompt: A surreal composition featuring a vibrant green eye with intricate purple patterns at the center of a blooming purple cabbage rose, white branching lightning bolts crackling around it, a melting hot pink heart dripping thick magenta liquid downwards, all enclosed inside a large translucent iridescent bubble, smaller floating eyes and black ink splatters in the dark purple background, highly detailed, psychedelic atmosphere
